usage: llm-modelbench inventory [-h] [--json] [--mock] [--auto]
                                [--runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json
  --mock                use offline stub model list
  --auto                also run functional capability probes
  --runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE
                        saved runtime profile; explicit selection takes
                        precedence
